text: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects and phenomena, encompassing the cosmos ranging from the largest galaxies to the tiniest particles. A fundamental aspect of this vast field is the examination of craters, which are distinctive impact features on the surfaces of planets and moons. Craters often reveal information about a body’s history, such as its formation and geological changes. While orbit provides the broad perspective necessary to understand the solar system’s vast scale, it is the detailed examination of craters that offers insights into individual celestial bodies. This knowledge is crucial for researchers seeking to unravel the secrets of our universe’s formation and evolution.
